@description:
 Leather-crafts, Metal-crafts, Rope Mastery, Scribing, Service,
 Sewing/Weaving, Skinning, Stone-crafts, Trapping, Wood-crafts This category
 encompasses the use of particular craftsman skills, such as making jewelry,
 copper etching, cloth work, etc. Note that these skills are all physical
 applications of skill to produce a desired object or product. Skills
 dealing with the abstract analysis or theory of these obects should fall
 instead under the Technical/Trade Group. The list above is not exhaustive;
 there is a nearly infinite number of possible crafts. The following is a
 partial list of suggested crafts not defined within this section (each of
 which is developed separately): • Barber: Hair groomer and shaver of
 beards, etc. • Billeting: Innkeeping duties . • Book Maker: Binds paper
 into books. • Calligraphy: Attractive form of writing. • Candle Maker: Use
 of wax and wicks to make candles. • Ceramics: Glazing, staining of pottery,
 glass, etc. and firing it in a kiln to harden it. • Cooper: Making or
 repairing of barrels. • Crocheting: See Knitting. • Dying: Coloring of
 fabric and cloth. • Embalmer: Mummification of body after death. •
 Embroidering: Decorating of fabric, cloth and leather. • Enameler: Use of
 enamel to place a hard, long-lasting surface on objects. • Furrier: Turning
 furs into clothing. • Glass Blower: Turning of sand into glass objects. •
 Guide: Pointing the way and leading. • Knitting: Turning yarn and thread
 into cloth, using needles. • Masseur/Masseuse: Manipulation of bones and
 muscle to relieve tension, etc. • Messenger/Runner: Bearer of messages
 (written or verbal). • Miller: Grinder of grains into flour. • Net Maker:
 Make and repair of fishing nets. • Paper making: Turning wood pulp into
 paper, reeds into papyrus, • Potter: Turning clay into objects. • Quilting:
 Turning pieces of cloth into blankets, clothing, etc. • Roofer: Putting
 roofs together, and maintaining them. • Sail Maker: Making and repairing of
 sails. • Scribe: One who copies manuscripts or other documents. •
 Seneschal: Running of a household, daily routines, etc. • Spinner: Turning
 wool or flax into thread. • Stewardship: Management of land and people in
 the absence of the overlord. • Tailoring: Turning cloth into articles of
 clothing. • Taxidermist: Preparing and stuffing the skins of animals. •
 Trapper: Capturing of animals either alive or dead. • Tube Hollower:
 Hollows tubes out of stone, metal, wood, etc. • Upholstery: Covering of
 furniture with material for decoration or comfort. • Valet: Assists others
 in getting dressed and ready for various occasions. • Weaving: Using Loom
 to make rugs, cloth, tapestries, etc. • Wicker Worker: Use of wicker to
 make baskets, furniture, etc.

# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS
# ===================================================================

@@ Cooking
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus cooking or preparing food. skill bonus may also
 be used when detecting bad food, preparing/neutralizing dangerous food
 ingredients. The following is a partial listing of cookery skills: •
 Baking: Turning of flour into breads, cakes, pies, etc. • Brewing: Making
 ale, beer, cider, malt or mead beverages. • Curing: Salting or preserving
 of food. • Distilling: Making of alcohol. • Winery: Making of wines.

@@ Drafting
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus to draw an item, object, blue etc. This is not
 free hand drawing; specialized drafting equipment (squares, triangles,
 compasses, etc.) is used in making accurate and precise drawings (normally
 to scale).

@@ Fletching
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for making an arrow available wood, metal,
 paper, and/or feathers. Note: With skill, sophisticated types of special
 purpose arrows may crafted (such as hunting, armor piercing, message,
 howling, poison bearing, etc.).

@@ Horticulture
@stat: Em
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for growing flowers, fruits, and vegetables. It
 includes the feeding, care, and harvesting such plants.

@@ Leather-crafts
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for working with hides and creating leather
 goods (e.g., leather armor, bolas, etc.). The following is a partial
 listing of leather crafts: • Cobbler: Making of shoes and boots. • Saddler:
 Making of saddles and other horse trappings. • Tanner: Turning hides into
 leather. • Tooler: Decorating leather with imprinted designs & coloring

@@ Metal-crafts
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for working with normal metals create or repair
 desired objects (e.g., horse shoes, metal ments). Bonus for oven or kiln
 building, and doubling effects fires. The following is a partial listing
 of smithing crafts (each separate skill that must be developed separately):
 • Armorer: Making of iron or steel armor. • Blacksmith: Making of small
 iron wares, horse shoes, etc. • Bronze Smith: Working and casting of
 bronze. • Copper Smith: Working and casting of copper. • Etcher: Decorating
 of metals. • Fire Starting: Starting of fires. • Foundry: Casting, rolling,
 cutting and spinning of iron. • Gold Smith: Working of gold into ornamental
 and functional • Iron Smith: Making of iron wares. • Silver Smith: Working
 of silver into ornamental and functional • Tin Smith: Working of tin into
 ornamental and functional items. • Tooler: Making of metal tools. • Weapon
 Smith: Making of iron or steel weapons.

@@ Rope Mastery
@stat: In
@description:
 This This skill provides a bonus for knot recognition, knot-tying, or
 braiding, rope splicing, making a maneuver while suspended from a rope (or
 analogous flexible line), or when throwing a line.

@@ Scribing
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill gives proficiency in secretarial skills, including calligraphy,
 taking dictation and librarian skills.

@@ Service
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill gives a bonus to performing service duties, such prints, those
 of a valet, maid, butler, etc.

@@ Sewing/Weaving
@stat: In
@description:
 This provides a bonus to static maneuvers involving sewing weaving. These
 skills includes fashioning garments, blankets, etc., as well as repairing
 such items. out of

@@ Skinning
@stat: In
@description:
 this This skill provides a bonus for removing, preparing, treating be and
 caring for animal skins. Note that while this would allow simple drape to
 be fashioned, this does not provide the sewing skills necessary to create
 normal garments.

@@ Stone-crafts
@stat: In
@description:
 fungi This skill provides a bonus for working with stone and creating of
 sculptures, writings, or any other form of inscription or relief. The
 following is a partial listing of stone crafts, each of which is a separate
 skill that must be developed separately: • Brick Maker: Making of bricks. •
 Gem Cutter: Cutting and setting of stones and gems. • Masonry: Making of
 building, bridges, roads, etc. from bricks stone. • Stone Carving: Carving
 of stone. them. • Stone Cutter: Cutting and shaping large stones from a
 quarry.

@@ Trapping
@stat: Em
@description:
 to This skill provides a bonus to trapping skills, including setting
 ornasimple snares, identifying animal runs, and a knowledge of of values of
 various furs, skins, etc.

@@ Wood-crafts
@stat: In
@description:
 is a This skill provides a bonus for fashioning any object out of required
 amount of wood, bone or similar material. The following is a partial
 listing of wood crafts, each of which is a separate skill that must be
 developed separately: • Carpentry: Cabinet maker. • Cartwright: Maker of
 carts, wagons and other similar vehicles. • Building: Construction of
 buildings from wood. • Lumbering: Felling of trees. • Shipwright: Building
 of sea going vessels. items. • Wheelwright: Maker of wheels. • Wood
 Carving: Carving of wood. items.

-26 down | Spectacular Failure | -100% | 2.5u | -50 | You have failed miserably in your craft. However, you are so oblivious and self-absorbed that you are convinced that you have, in fact, succeeded admirably. Your misguided efforts generate results similar to Absolute Failure, below, but you will defend yourself until irrefutable evidence is presented to you that you have failed.
-25 — 04 | Absolute Failure | -50% | 1.5u | -30 | In your haste, you have actually created extra work for yourself. The time to complete this task normally is doubled, and you have misplaced, misused or broken some or all of the people, tools or materials used in this task. You may not try again until 24 hours have passed, and that attempt will then be at a modification of -20.
05 — 75 | Failure | 0% | 1.0u | +0 | Your skills have deserted you, and you have wasted your effort. Hurts, don’t it?
UM 66 | Unusual Event | 100% | 1.5u | +10 | You have a great idea for a unique style for your craftwork, and after an arduous effort, you successfully realize your work. Unfortunately, unbeknownst to you, another local craftsman has had the same idea before you, and your work is seen as a bald imitation. Lips curl.
76 — 90 | Partial Success | 30% | 1.75u | +5 | You know what you want to accomplish, but it just keeps falling short. Perhaps a different approach. Wait a full day before attempting this skill again.
UM 100 | Unusual Success | 150% | 2.5u | +40 | You have achieved a perfect union of form and function. Your craftwork may be up to 30% lighter or heavier (player’s choice), and has an inherent non-magical bonus of +10 in addition to any other qualities. In addition, with an equivalent effort, you may reproduce this object exactly with a result of Absolute Success any time in the future. This could be your big-ticket item!
91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 1.5u | +10 | You aren’t quite on, it seems. The small details keep escaping you, but you may yet manage to catch up. It takes a bit longer, but you may roll again with a +10 modification to finish your maneuver.
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +20 | Your hands are sure, and your work is precise and artful. You got etc. the knack.
176 up | Absolute Success | 120% | 0.8u | +30 | Your diligence is rewarded with your latest masterwork! Everyone can see the remarkable quality of your work, and your abilities will be more highly regarded than ever.
